review_evidence: cvc5.lean and cvc5/{Init,Kind,ProofRule,SkolemId,Types}.lean define the public Lean binding surface.
cvc5Test/Unit/* exercises the binding with concrete typed API constructions and is retained as useful formal/interface search evidence rather than blanket-excluding tests.

PreBuild.lean defines parser datatypes/combinators and code-generation functions; lakefile.lean defines nontrivial Lake helpers/targets, so excluding either whole file would hide unique declarations even though their role is operational.
summary: Reviewed the complete lean-cvc5 unit. The cvc5 bindings and tests are reusable formal/API evidence; PreBuild.lean and lakefile.lean are operational build machinery but contain substantial unique Lean declarations, so the lossless hard-exclusion gate requires retaining them.
